title: Body parts and five senses
examples: Teacher, what do I use to smell flowers?
Can you show me where my elbow is?
Which sense do I use to know if something is hot?

explain.say: Can you point to your nose for me please?
Your nose helps you to smell things around you.
Now, can you touch your eyes with one finger?
We use our eyes to see bright colours and shapes.
What part do you use to hear music playing?

faq.q: What do I use to hear sounds like dogs barking?
faq.a: You use your ears to hear sounds like barking. You can also ask, 'What part helps me hear?' or 'Which sense hears?'
asks: What do I use to hear sounds like dogs barking?

faq.q: How do I know if food tastes sweet or sour?
faq.a: You use your tongue inside your mouth to taste food. You might also ask, 'Which sense tastes?' or 'What do I use for taste?'
asks: How do I know if food tastes sweet or sour?
What do I use for taste?

faq.q: What sense do I use to touch a soft teddy bear?
faq.a: You use your hands and skin to feel things. You could also ask, 'What sense touches?' or 'How do I feel things?'
asks: What sense do I use to touch a soft teddy bear?

faq.q: Do I use my nose to see the rainbow?
faq.a: No, you use your eyes to see the rainbow colours. You could also ask, 'Do eyes see colours?' or 'Which sense sees rainbows?'
asks: Do I use my nose to see the rainbow?

faq.q: What are the five senses again?
faq.a: The five senses are sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch. You could also ask, 'Name the five senses?' or 'What are the five senses?'
asks: What are the five senses again?

facts: We have five main senses to help us explore the world.
Our eyes help us to see colours and light.
Our ears help us to hear loud and soft sounds.
Our nose helps us to smell nice flowers.
Our tongue helps us to taste sweet or salty things.

quiz.say: I see a bright red apple. Which sense did I use?
quiz.why: You use your eyes to see the colour red and the shape of the apple.

wrong.0: The nose is for smelling, not for seeing colours.
wrong.1: Ears help us hear sounds, not to see things.
wrong.2: The tongue is only for tasting food in your mouth.

quiz.say: A loud clap makes me hear. Which sense is this?
quiz.why: You use your ears to catch and hear sounds like clapping.

wrong.1: Eyes only help you to see what is happening.
wrong.2: The nose helps you smell, not to hear noises.
wrong.3: Skin helps you feel things, but not sounds.

quiz.say: If I eat a lemon, I taste sour. Which sense did I use?
quiz.why: The tongue is the part that lets you know if something is sour.

wrong.1: Eyes let you see the lemon, but not its taste.
wrong.2: The nose can smell the lemon, but not the taste.
wrong.3: Skin can feel the lemon, but not its sour taste.
